test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who is the author of the book ‘All From Memory: An Autobiography’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BV Acharya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **B.V. Acharya **is a **senior advocate **at the **Karnataka High court**. He is the **son of Ramachandra Acharya**, a **Shivalli Madhva Brahmin**, and **native of the Udupi district**.
 
• He has been the **advocate general **of the **Karnataka government several times**.
 
• He **wrote **a book named **All from Memory: An Autobiography**.
 
• This **book reveals **the firm **belief **of the **author that **contentment always leads to **happiness eliminating frustration**. Being an autobiography the book furnishes details of his **family and family background**. It also briefly explains his views on **matters of importance **in the **legal field **such as the **quality of an ideal judge**, the conduct of **judges in courts**, etc. The book also refers to the hardship which a public prosecutor has to face in sensational cases. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Leila Seth__** was an Indian judge who served as the first woman judge on the Delhi High Court and became the** first woman** to become** Chief Justice of a state High Court**, **Himachal Pradesh High Court, on 5 August 1991**.
 
• She was also the first woman to be designated as a **senior counsel **by the **Supreme Court of India**. 
 
• **__Margaret Alva __**is an Indian politician
 
• . Alva served as the 17th Governor of Goa, 23rd Governor of Gujarat, 20th Governor of Rajasthan and 4th Governor of Uttarakhand until the end of her tenure in August 2014.
 
• She has formerly served as the **Cabinet Minister**.
 
• __**Sita Ram Goel**__ was an Indian historian, religious and political activist, writer, and publisher in the late twentieth century
